scope: All existing/future organisations, departments, audience apps and cross-department workflows in the established system scope
status_rule: A milestone verifies only its stated scope. Every chain remains OPEN until applicable common checks and finish evidence pass. Historical statuses are preserved, not automatically recertified.

chains.name: Organisation, property and data isolation
chains.flow: Organisation setup → property configuration → role scope → property switch → reads/writes/documents/reports
chains.finish: Existing and new organisations work without fixed hotel IDs; foreign property/organisation access is denied in UI, RPC, storage and reports.
chains.next: Retain the 23 installed shared routines; verify actual staff property switching and hidden-record refusal.

chains.name: Staff identity, Users, roles, PIN and devices
chains.flow: Invite/create → approve/access → role assignment → sign-in/PIN/device pairing → recovery → suspend/revoke
chains.finish: The intended person has exactly their permitted scope; recovery email really arrives; privileged actions audit; revoked access stops working.
chains.next: Verify the supported privileged Users executor and role/audit parity; complete live recovery and paired-device checks.

chains.name: Shared business configuration and pricing
chains.flow: Currency/timezone/business date → tax/service/discount/rate/meal policy → calculation → bill → settlement → journal/report
chains.finish: Configured components propagate once with documented inclusion/exclusion, rounding, units and dates; optional charges need no fixed-name assumptions.
chains.next: Inventory actual policies and verify inclusive tax, new charge components, exemptions and rate changes using saved examples.

chains.name: Purchase request through approved LPO
chains.flow: Need/requisition → RFQ → supplier quotation → comparison/selection → approval → numbered LPO → supplier dispatch
chains.finish: Approved purchase, supplier, quantities/prices, approvals and actual outbound delivery evidence form one retrievable chain.
chains.next: Complete real role handoffs and supplier communication; retain the original approved document and delivery reference.

chains.name: Delivery, blind receiving and GRN
chains.roles: Receiver / independent reviewer / stock poster / Finance
chains.flow: Supplier delivery note/file → blind count → reconciliation → accepted/rejected/short → approval → GRN → stock/batch/cost → accrual
chains.finish: Only accepted quantities post; repeated/partial deliveries trace to original PO lines; GRN, lots, stock value and accrual agree; finance recovery does not repost stock.
chains.next: Verify installed guards and both authority paths; reconcile a real delivery and archive the supplier original.

chains.name: Supplier invoice, payable and payment
chains.flow: Supplier invoice → LPO/GRN/price/tax match → variance approval/rejection → payable/journal → schedule → release → settlement/remittance
chains.finish: Original purchase, accepted GRN, invoice, aging, payment and balanced journal agree; duplicate invoice/payment and incorrect journal reuse refuse.
chains.next: Verify AP dashboard/aging, approval and payment stages with source-linked journals and remittance output.

chains.name: Stores, station mapping and transfers
chains.flow: Owned item/base unit → physical store → departmental/station mapping → requisition/approval → dispatch → in-transit → receipt/return/cancel
chains.finish: Actual source/destination and authority are correct; base quantities, lots, saved cost and in-transit valuation reconcile without invented mappings.
chains.next: Obtain explicit-station repair postcheck, resolve remaining actual store choices, then verify transfer handoff and reports.

chains.name: Stock counts, adjustments, lots and expiry
chains.flow: Physical count → variance → independent approval → adjustment → lot/expiry coverage → valuation/report
chains.finish: Signed movements and FEFO allocations reconcile to balances; expired/blocked-lot policy is explicit; no silent negative stock or historical cost rewrite.
chains.next: Resolve existing batch/cost discrepancies, expired-lot policy, configured conversions and report parity.

chains.name: Menu, recipes, production and consumption
chains.roles: Kitchen / Bar / Coffee / Pastry / stock controller
chains.flow: Owned stock/menu binding → manual/import draft → review/activation → units/yield/sub-recipes → produce/sell → consume → waste/return
chains.finish: One intended active version uses owned property stock/store; direct-sale and batch units/costs agree; actual deductions/returns happen once with source IDs.
chains.next: Confirm 21-recipe/20-menu cleanup; verify staff save/import/activation and real station depletion; resolve skipped consumption coverage.

chains.name: POS order and production handoff
chains.flow: Table/channel order → item/modifiers → send → scoped station ticket/display → accept/prepare/ready → serve → approved void/return
chains.finish: Prices/options persist atomically; correct department receives each item; paid/pending-protected lines cannot drift; lost-response item retry cannot duplicate a sale.
chains.next: Verify all station channels, reconnect/handoffs, item-attempt identity and authentic recovery of the historical KES51 sale.

chains.name: POS collections and settlement
chains.flow: Amount due → cash/card/bank/M-Pesa/QR attempt → pending/confirmation/callback → receipt → allocations → journal → close/refund
chains.finish: Only verified receipts reduce debt once; split tenders, cash change, provider uncertainty, late callbacks and recovery retain the original attempt and source.
chains.next: Trace real existing attempts; verify installed start/dispatch and recovery contracts, partial tenders, pending card/QR and cashier close.

chains.name: Delivery, rider and remittance
chains.flow: Guest order → quote/payment intent → preparation → rider assignment/dispatch → delivery/proof → cash handover/remittance → settlement/refund
chains.finish: Guest, dispatcher and rider see the same scoped order; delivery status does not invent payment; collected cash and remittance/journal agree.
chains.next: Verify guest-to-rider handoffs, failed/cancelled deliveries, collected-cash reconciliation and app recovery.

chains.name: Availability, quote, reservation and deposit
chains.flow: Dates/availability → rate/room/meal/tax quote → reservation/confirmation → deposit request → confirmed receipt → held liability/history
chains.finish: Nights, quote, deposit requirement and confirmed money reconcile; availability/property/date checks hold; pending money is separate and retry is once-only.
chains.next: Run corrected existing-ID money inspection and trace actual bookings, receipts, pending requests and quote differences.

chains.name: Arrival and deposit application
chains.flow: Eligible reservation → identity/deposit gate → room assignment → check-in → stay/folio → one deposit application → first accommodation charge
chains.finish: Reservation, stay, room and folio agree; held deposit transfers without a second receipt/revenue entry; first-night and original liability journals reconcile.
chains.next: Verify one real arrival and the original deposit/payment/application IDs, including waivers, denied arrival and rollback.

chains.name: In-house stay, room move and night audit
chains.flow: Assigned stay → room/type/rate changes → consecutive business-day accommodation → taxes/service → adjustments → audit close
chains.finish: No missing/duplicate nights or double quote charges; room moves preserve ownership, date/rate history and balances; audit refuses incomplete financial evidence.
chains.next: Verify installed nightly/pricing guards and actual consecutive days, adjustments, future-date refusal and business-date reporting.

chains.name: Minibar, room service, laundry and guest services
chains.roles: Housekeeping / station staff / laundry / front desk
chains.flow: Service intake/consumption → correct current stay/room/folio/store → fulfilment/stock → charge → delivery/return → history/journal
chains.finish: Each operational source is billed once with correct quantities, tax/service, stock and durable historical identity; non-folio settlement is accounted for.
chains.next: Verify installed durable Minibar with staff, actual store designation, room-service transfers and laundry intake/processing/delivery/billing.

chains.name: Corporate/group credit and folio allocation
chains.roles: Front desk / corporate accounts / credit controller / Finance
chains.flow: Corporate/group authority → room/master/guest folios → routing/transfers → deposits/payments → allocation → invoice/credit account → collection
chains.finish: Every included folio and shared master reconciles separately; credit cannot hide another folio's debt; one receipt cannot be allocated twice.
chains.next: Complete shared-master/split-allocation behavior and actual corporate-credit settlement; retain installed multi-folio checkout.

chains.name: Departure, refunds and room release
chains.roles: Front desk / authorized override/refund approver / cashier
chains.flow: Review every folio → settle/refund/authorized credit departure → checkout → release assignments → vacant dirty → issued final history
chains.finish: Each debt/credit has evidence and authority; room transition is saved; maintenance holds survive; repeated checkout/refund cannot duplicate effects.
chains.next: Reconcile actual reservation/POS room-charge money, including prior POS payments, then verify departure and refund journal evidence.

chains.name: Housekeeping, inspection and sellability
chains.flow: Vacant dirty/in-house task → assign → clean → linen/amenity use → independent inspection → sellable availability
chains.finish: Dirty, uninspected or maintenance-held rooms cannot be sold early; room axes, tasks, consumption and front-desk availability agree.
chains.next: Verify real departure-to-clean/inspect handoff, blocked-room refusal and inspector permissions.

chains.name: Assets, maintenance and room holds
chains.flow: Fault/asset/PM → work order/assignment → hold → parts/work log → completion → independent verification → closure → dirty-room handback
chains.finish: Parts/cost/asset history persist; concurrent work orders retain holds; technician cannot self-release an unverified room; cleaning remains required.
chains.next: Run actual repair/hold/verification and competing-work-order regressions; verify asset history and departmental stock effects.

chains.name: Events and departmental fulfilment
chains.flow: Enquiry → quotation/version → contract/approval → deposit → event booking/BEO → departmental tasks/stock → delivery → final invoice/payment/cancel
chains.finish: Approved event version drives BEO, quantities, assignments and billing; existing invoices are reused; deposits and cancellation/refund obligations reconcile.
chains.next: Verify real event handoffs, approved versions, final billing and quotation/contract/confirmation/BEO retrieval.

chains.name: HR, attendance, scheduling and payroll
chains.flow: Employee/contract → roster → attendance/leave/approval → payroll inputs → review/release → payout/journal → payslip/history
chains.finish: Authorized employee/period figures reconcile; release gates and payroll privacy hold; staff letters/contracts/schedules and payslips retain source identity.
chains.next: Inventory actual HR/payroll scenarios, verify approval/release/access and money/document parity with the existing configured payroll process.

chains.name: Finance, receivables, cashbook and close
chains.roles: Finance clerk / approver / accountant / night auditor
chains.flow: Operational source → classification/recognition → journal → register/cashbook/AR/AP → reconciliation → shift/business-date/period close → reversal
chains.finish: Revenue, deposits, tax/service/tips, refunds, receivables and liabilities are classified correctly; posted journals balance and reconcile to original records/reports.
chains.next: Reconcile real operational source IDs and accounts; verify period/shift close, original journal identity and controlled reversals.

chains.name: Every required document and lifecycle
chains.flow: Approved saved source/version → preview → numbered issue → PDF/download → print/send → retrieval after status change → reprint/supersession
chains.finish: Correct identity/logo/fields/currency/timezone/amounts and access; all required outputs exist or use an explicit uploaded original; reprint never creates a transaction.
chains.next: Complete the document register below, alternative/missing generators, long/multipage cases and actual source-to-render comparison.

chains.name: Printer and production-output routing
chains.flow: Document/ticket → browser/OS or paired agent → scoped printer/queue → transport acknowledgement → correct paper → offline/retry/reprint
chains.finish: User-reported working printer is preserved; each required receipt/A4/station output has correct paper/layout and backup behavior; acknowledgement is distinct from paper.
chains.next: Extend the successful physical test to required document types, Kitchen/Bar/Coffee/Pastry routes and safe uncertain-outcome/reprint handling.

chains.name: Approvals, tasks, communications and automation
chains.roles: Requester / delegated approver / assignee / communications owner
chains.flow: Business trigger → approval/task/rule → correct recipient/scope → provider dispatch → delivery/failure/retry → audit/history/escalation
chains.finish: No false sent/success labels, duplicate outbound action or unauthorized approval; correct record links, provider references and human handoff persist.
chains.next: Verify approved runtime paths, actual email/SMS/notification delivery, scheduling/retry/timezone and automation-to-business-action authority.

chains.name: Public guest discovery and self-service
chains.flow: Property listing → room/menu/event discovery → booking/order → deposit/payment → confirmation → stay requests/folio/documents → departure feedback
chains.finish: Guest sees correct property, quote and saved work across inner routes; private staff/customer data remains protected and failed/expired sessions recover.
chains.next: Walk the guest entry and inner flows on the latest build, including configured photography, real source links and mobile/back navigation.

chains.name: Security, visitors, incidents and handover
chains.roles: Security officer / supervisor / authorized operations staff
chains.flow: Visitor/vehicle/incident/lost-property intake → assignment/patrol/escalation → authorized closure/return → shift handover → audit/report
chains.finish: Identity/privacy and property limits hold; chain of custody, accountable handover and incident evidence remain linked after closure.
chains.next: Inventory and verify existing security workflows and their operations/task/stock handoffs under actual roles.

chains.name: Reports, dashboards, analytics and AI answers
chains.flow: Saved operational/financial source → scoped facts → period/filter/aggregation → dashboard/report/AI explanation → export → drill-back
chains.finish: Figures, definitions, currency/timezone and filters agree with source/ledger; AI output cites available records and does not fabricate completion.
chains.next: Reconcile financial and operational reports plus every management exporter; test denied scope, stale refresh and reproducible drill-back.

chains.name: Release, runtime and operational reliability
chains.flow: Reviewed source → installed-contract comparison → checks/build/artifact → deploy → live identity → monitoring/live refresh → backup/restore/recovery
chains.finish: App/SQL/agent versions are compatible; no unknown newer repair is overwritten; secrets stay private; real runtime, reconnect, performance and recovery are evidenced.
chains.next: Retain the verified 19 November preview/SQL milestone; finish original Horizon publication parity, live runtime gaps and rollback/recovery acceptance.

chains.name: CRM, sales, marketing and loyalty
chains.flow: Customer/lead identity → consent/preferences → enquiry/opportunity → offer/campaign/loyalty → booking/sale → delivery/outcome → account history
chains.finish: Deduplicated scoped identity links the actual booking/sale; consent, eligibility, redemptions and provider outcomes persist without fabricated sends.
chains.next: Inventory configured CRM/loyalty/campaign paths and verify real source linkage, permissions, opt-out and outcome reporting.

chains.name: Transport, fleet and operational handoffs
chains.flow: Transport request → vehicle/driver availability → approval/assignment → trip/service/expenses → completion/handover → cost/asset/report
chains.finish: Where configured, assignments, movement, expenses and asset history agree; unauthorized/double allocation and unsupported actions are explicit.
chains.next: Inventory implemented transport/fleet routes and required hotel use cases; repair or explicitly account for missing workflow steps.

chains.name: Supplier/partner account and external handoffs
chains.flow: Invitation/access → scoped catalogue/quote/document → order/approval → fulfilment evidence → invoice/account/payment → support/history
chains.finish: External users see only authorized owned records; supplier originals, acknowledgements and account balances connect to the internal purchase/finance chain.
chains.next: Walk existing partner/supplier routes and actual inbound/outbound handoffs; distinguish manual record keeping from delivered communication.

chains.name: All audience apps, displays and presentation
chains.roles: Guest / supplier / rider / employee / display operator
chains.flow: Correct audience entry → sign-in/device/PWA → inner routes/actions → handoff/deep-link → loading/error/empty/offline → back/re-entry/session recovery
chains.finish: Guest, partner, rider, staff and displays finish their intended tasks on mobile/desktop; navigation, accessibility, contrast and OS handoffs are coherent.
chains.next: Inventory all audience routes and visible actions, then verify functioning inner flows, device identity, public-data exposure and measured performance.

execution_task_ledger.rule: Finish and verify the scoped task, record remaining installation/live evidence, then take the next independent task. A local pass does not close its workflow chain.

common_acceptance_checks: Record lineage: trigger and every saved source/destination ID, organization/property, actor and status transition.
Money/units/dates: configured pricing and components, inclusive/exclusive tax, discounts, service, deposits, pending money, rounding, currency, base units and business dates.
Downstream effects: stock/lot/value, room/task/asset state, operational registers and balanced source-linked journals; mark a genuinely inapplicable effect N/A with a reason.
Authority/isolation: real requester/approver/operator roles, organization/property/department/station boundaries and explicit denied cases.
Failure/retry: validation, partial failure/rollback, duplicate clicks, concurrent actions, lost responses, callbacks, reconnect and replay retain the original attempt.
Corrections/history: reject, cancel, void, transfer, return, refund, reversal and supersession follow policy and retain original records/audit.
Outputs: relevant preview/PDF/download/send/print/reprint/retrieval and physical/provider proof; sending/queuing/transport/paper are distinct states.
Installed/deployed acceptance: installed routine/permissions, app/agent build, actual role/browser/device, expected versus observed result and open exceptions.
